title: Borrow subtraction decrements value
statement: For every Boolean word of positive little-endian value, subtracting an incoming borrow flag set to true produces a word whose little-endian value plus one equals the original word's value.
hypotheses_covered: The input is a Boolean word
The little-endian value of the word is positive
replaced:
If a word has positive little-endian value, then the value of the word
obtained by subtracting a set borrow flag is exactly one less than the value
of the original word.
